headlines.summary_en: Xinhongye announced that the company plans to issue convertible corporate bonds to unspecified investors, raising no more than RMB 1.1 billion (including issuance costs), with proceeds used after deducting issuance costs for projects such as R&D and industrialization of lightweight metal composite conductor cables and working capital. headlines.title_en: PBOC: Total assets of financial institutions reached 562.2 trillion yuan by end of Q2 2026
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China stated that, according to preliminary statistics, as of the end of Q2 2026, total assets of China's financial institutions stood at RMB 562.2 trillion, up 7.7% year on year. Of this, banking institutions' total assets were RMB 497.98 trillion, up 6.6%; securities institutions' total assets were RMB 20.37 trillion, up 29.8%; and insurance institutions' total assets were RMB 43.86 trillion, up 11.8%.

headlines.title_en: Rise of 'Token loans' as banks compete in computing-power finance track
headlines.summary_en: A report published by China Economic Information Service, titled "Signal from China Economic News | 'Token loans' emerge as banks race in computing power finance," said that recently, Guangdong Province's first specialized financial product for the token economy, the "Token loan," was launched in Haizhu District, Guangzhou. Bank of China's Guangzhou Branch granted credit of about RMB 28 million to related enterprises. In addition, China Construction Bank, Agricultural Bank of China, Jiangsu Bank, Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank, and Zhangjiagang Rural Commercial Bank have also introduced computing power-related credit products, incorporating computing power, computing efficiency, and token consumption into credit assessments.

headlines.title: China’s factory activity improves in August, but stays in contraction
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity improved in August but remained in contraction territory for a second straight month, as a pickup in orders could not fully offset the impact of overall weak domestic demand and disruptions from extreme weather.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) was 49.8 in August, up from 49.2 in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Monday. The reading was largely in line with the 49.85 projection from economists polled by the...
headlines.title_zh: 中国8月工厂活动改善，但仍处于收缩区间
headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月工厂活动有所改善，但连续第二个月处于收缩区间，因订单回升未能完全抵消整体内需疲软和极端天气干扰的影响。数据显示，8月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）为49.8，高于7月的49.2。

headlines.title_en: MIIT and nine other departments: Establish second phase of National SME Development Fund to drive social capital into early-stage, small-scale, long-term, and hard-tech investments
headlines.summary_en: Ten departments including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Promoting the Development of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises." Strengthen direct financing support. Enhance efforts to cultivate SME listings, establish a cultivation pool for high-quality listed SMEs, and promote normalized equity financing connections. Deepen the construction of the 'Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative' board in regional equity trading markets. Build a high-quality 'Technology Board' in the bond market to support eligible SMEs in bond financing. Vigorously develop venture capital and establish the Phase II National SME Development Fund to drive social capital toward early-stage, small-scale, long-term, and hard-tech investments.

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM: Service trade imports and exports totaled 4.44671 trillion yuan in Jan-July 2026, up 8.3% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: A spokesperson from the Department of Trade in Services of the Ministry of Commerce introduced services trade developments for January-July 2026. In January-July 2026, China's total services imports and exports reached RMB 4,446.71 billion, up 8.3% year on year. Exports were RMB 1,773.23 billion, up 17.1%; imports were RMB 2,673.48 billion, up 3.2%. The services trade deficit was RMB 900.25 billion, narrowing by RMB 176.33 billion year on year.

headlines.title_en: MIIT and nine other departments: Continue cultivating specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative SMEs and 'little giant' firms

headlines.title_en: Service trade imports and exports up 8.3% year-on-year in first seven months
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the Ministry of Commerce on the 3rd showed that from January to July this year, China's total services imports and exports reached RMB 4,446.71 billion, up 8.3% year on year. The services trade deficit was RMB 900.25 billion, narrowing by RMB 176.33 billion year on year. Specifically, travel and transport services exports contributed over 50% to overall services export growth. From January to July, travel services exports were RMB 263.61 billion, up 27.7%, and transport services exports were RMB 363.23 billion, up 27.1%. headlines.summary: 商务部发布消息，服贸司负责人介绍我国2026年1到7月服务贸易发展情况。2026年1到7月，我国服务进出口总额44467.1亿元，同比增长8.3%。其中，出口17732.3亿元，增长17.1%；进口26734.8亿元，增长3.2%。服务贸易逆差9002.5亿元，同比缩小1763.3亿元。主要呈现以下特点：旅行和运输服务出口对整体服务出口增长的贡献率超过50%。知识密集型服务出口占比超过一半。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM: Service trade imports and exports rose 8.3% year-on-year from January to July
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced that a spokesperson from the Department of Trade in Services introduced China's services trade developments from January to July 2026. In January-July 2026, total services imports and exports reached RMB 4,446.71 billion, up 8.3% year on year. Exports were RMB 1,773.23 billion, up 17.1%; imports were RMB 2,673.48 billion, up 3.2%. The services trade deficit was RMB 900.25 billion, narrowing by RMB 176.33 billion year on year. Main features: travel and transport services exports contributed over 50% to overall exports growth. Knowledge-intensive services exports accounted for over half of total exports. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Feilong Auto: Recently, controlling shareholder reduced stake by 0.9% of total share capital; current non-automotive business revenue accounts for a relatively low proportion of overall company revenue.
headlines.summary_en: Feilong Auto Parts announced that the company's stock closed higher for two consecutive trading days with a cumulative deviation of 20.79%, constituting abnormal fluctuation. After verification, the company's production and operations are normal, with no major changes in its main business. As of the close on September 3, 2026, controlling shareholder Wanxi Holding cumulatively reduced 5.1607 million shares during the reduction period, accounting for 0.8979% of total share capital. From September 1-3, 2026, the company participated in strategy meetings in Shanghai hosted by institutions including GF Securities, Changjiang Securities, and Soochow Securities, communicating with brokers, funds, and other institutions. Currently, non-automotive business revenue accounts for a relatively low proportion of overall revenue, and investors are advised to be mindful of investment risks.

headlines.title_en: Beijing Vice Mayor Sun Shuo visited the Beijing Stock Exchange and presided over a working meeting of Beijing's enterprise listing service task force.
headlines.summary_en: On September 2, Beijing Vice Mayor Sun Shuo, on the occasion of the fifth anniversary of the Beijing Stock Exchange's establishment, surveyed the BSE market construction and chaired a Beijing service enterprise listing working group meeting, hearing updates on corporate listing services and listed company development in Beijing and studying next steps. Officials from the Beijing Financial Regulatory Bureau, Beijing Cyberspace Administration, Beijing Municipal Science & Technology Commission and Zhongguancun Administrative Committee, Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology, Beijing SASAC, Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission, Xicheng District, Haidian District, Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area, Beijing CSRC bureau, and the Beijing Stock Exchange attended the meeting. (BSE release)

headlines.title_en: Waller's Dovish Tone Sends U.S. Bond Yields Lower! Tonight's Focus Shifts to U.S. Nonfarm Payrolls Data.
headlines.summary_en: Waller's dovish remarks send US Treasury yields lower! Focus shifts to US nonfarm payrolls tonight. Beyond central bank officials' comments, US economic data released Thursday was mixed. Weekly jobless claims remained near the lower end of the post-pandemic range. The August services activity index growth beat expectations, but its employment subindex contracted for a second straight month, and the prices paid index rose to a four-year high. Currently, beyond inflation, Fed policy expectations also hinge on labor market conditions, which the August nonfarm payrolls report from the US Labor Department tonight will clarify.
